title: Offsite encryption algorithm, envelope and keyring contract

architecture_decision.reason: The existing backup pipeline already owns BackupRecord evidence, full R2 readback, asset-root manifests, retention and restore-validation semantics. Replacing it with restic in FR-05 would duplicate or bypass those controls. Client-side AEAD is added to the existing object path instead.

algorithm_contract.nonce_generation: cryptographically secure random unique nonce per encrypted object

envelope_contract.restore_acceptance: A ciphertext object is not accepted until AEAD authentication succeeds and decrypted plaintext SHA-256 and size match the authenticated header/manifest evidence.

object_naming_contract.legacy_plaintext_r2_objects: must remain readable only through explicit legacy restore compatibility until retention removes them; new backups after encrypted rollout must not upload plaintext database.dump, three-d.tar, platform-assets.tar or manifest.json objects

format.keys: map of key_id to 32-byte base64url key material plus lifecycle status/created_at

old_key_deletion_requires: no retained local/offsite backup references the key_id
retention cleanup for those backups has completed
independent recovery copy policy has been satisfied
rotation_contract.lost_required_key: raise explicit unrecoverable-backup incident; never silently skip the affected retained generation

recovery_copy_contract.location: operator-controlled recovery location outside this server and outside the R2 backup bucket/prefix

scope_boundary.fr05_protects: offsite R2 backup objects before upload
fr05_does_not_claim: protection from a live root process that can read mounted keys
